description: GTFS_zip is a dataset listed in Dades Obertes FGC open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ferrocarrils de la Generalitat de Catalunya (FGC). Proporciona en formato zip todos los archivos que integran el GTFS de FGC. Puede descargar este conjunto de datos en formato zip a través del siguiente enlace: Para más información sobre el formato GTFS consultar:. Coverage: Catalonia (Ferrocarrils de la Generalitat de Catalunya network). The portal files it under Infraestructuras y estaciones, Itinerarios y horarios, Información institucional. Its keywords are gtfs, zip, archivos. The portal shows 8 records. The portal shows 2026-09-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution License 4.0 (cc-by 4.0) (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-dadesobertes-fgc-cat-portal.
